body.x: KAMON(www.kamon.tv) will showcase '360-degree Photography VR Filming System' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show in Las vegas, U.S. that will be held from January 7th to 10th.

'360-degree Photography VR Filming System' let users choose the angle and interactively pan around and look at the view in different directions. It attracts a lot of attention from next generation brand-new media. Especially it realizes hybrid mixed video of various contents such as advertising, education, sightseeing and performance. Equipped with HMD(Head Mounted Display), it gets an optimized usability for virtual reality.

As launched at KBS Hotplace 360, it produces contents of documentary, entertainment, music and sightseeing. It provides 360 Movie not only on website but also on iOS, Android, Window PC, Smart TV, Set-top Box.

"We will prospect for new partner companies and also new markets through the show" said the officials, "with showcasing KAMON's integrated service, we will strengthen our position as a killer contents on HMD, Smart TV"

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
